flow: Computes SHA-256 canonical input fingerprint over all execution parameters
Atomically claims cycle execution in SQLite agent_cycle_executions table
Orchestrator prepares context, admits run, invokes InvestigationSupervisor
Supervisor integrates delegation results into working state proposals
StateTransitionPolicy and GroundingValidator accept or reject proposals
Atomically commits new state revision and appends trajectory event
Re-verifies task existence and caches completed cycle outcome JSON

point_2_llm_invocation_steps: FinalSemanticReviewRunner (finalization review, only if finalization requested)

point_3_specialist_independent_llm.mechanism: When supervisor proposes delegations, each admitted delegation triggers an independent specialist PydanticAI run with tool definitions

point_4_retry_configuration.sdk_retries: Controlled by OpenAI client transport configuration
point_4_retry_configuration.budget_guard: RequestBudgetGuard wraps client to strictly enforce max 18 physical attempts

point_6_revision_transaction_boundary.mechanism: SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction in commit_working_state
point_6_revision_transaction_boundary.guards: Strict optimistic revision check (latest == expected) and DB triggers enforcing monotonicity and hash-chaining

point_7_task_deletion_coordination.post_check: Immediately after orchestrator execution before outcome commit
point_7_task_deletion_coordination.behavior: Returns HTTP 404, marks execution failed, prevents zombie writes

point_8_tool_registry_write_capabilities.investigation_db_write: Append-only tool observation logs into agent_tool_observations table
